Moderate lipophilicity (logP 1-4) provides the driving force for membrane partitioning. Molecular weight < 500 Da. Intramolecular hydrogen bonds can "mask" polar groups and improve permeability beyond what TPSA alone would predict — this is exploited in cyclic peptide drug design.
